messages:
ops-bot: Alert: notify-service error-rate > 5% for 3m. Creating incident INC-4578 and attempting to page @oncall-rotation via PagerFlow.
Sara Li: I didn't get paged. anyone else?
Tom Nguyen: Confirmed — incident-bot logs show PagerFlow webhook returning 401.
Alex Patel: @ops-bot paste the webhook payload/logs please.
ops-bot: logs: ```
POST /pagerflow/v1/events 401 Unauthorized
time=1714508389 method=POST status=401 body="invalid token"
headers: x-request-id=xyz-123
```
Maria Gomez: Ugh, I rotated the PagerFlow API key at 17:55 as part of maintenance but forgot to update the k8s secret for incident-bot.
Sara Li: OK urgent: page on-call manually and we'll fix the token. @Michael Chen can you answer manual page?
Michael Chen: On it, I just got a manual SMS and I'm calling in. Investigating.
Tom Nguyen: While we wait for manual ack, we should verify scope of customer impact. Alex can you run a quick query?
Alex Patel: Running a quick rate check: notify-service failures spiked from 0.1% -> 3.4% between 17:52-17:58 UTC. Most are 401 from PagerFlow calls.
infra-automation: Command run to check secret: ```
kubectl -n infra get secret pagerflow-token -o yaml
# shows old token hash - lastUpdated: 2024-05-01T17:50:00Z
```
Maria Gomez: Pushing updated secret now: `kubectl -n infra set secret generic pagerflow-token --from-literal=token=REDACTED-NEW` and then `kubectl rollout restart deploy/incident-bot`.
Sara Li: Good. Alex, can you also flip notify-router to fallback to SMS for notify-service while we recover?
Alex Patel: Doing that: `POST /_admin/routes` -> set fallback=sms for service=notify-service. Should be effective within ~30s.
ops-bot: Manual escalation message to @oncall-rotation delivered; ack received from Michael Chen.
Michael Chen: I see the error traces. Looks like incident-bot retried but got 401 for each retry window. I'm confirming whether any customer PII touched (looks like none).
Tom Nguyen: Maria, status on redeploy?
Maria Gomez: Redeploy kicked at 17:58:20, incident-bot pods restarted. Waiting for healthcheck.
ops-bot: After redeploy, PagerFlow responses changed: ```
POST /pagerflow/v1/events 202 Accepted
time=1714509460 request_id=abc-789
```
Sara Li: Can we confirm pages actually went through during the recovery window?
Alex Patel: PagerFlow logs show successful deliveries from 17:58:40 onwards. Delivery failure window ~17:52-17:58 UTC.
Michael Chen: Investigating customer impact: approx 3% of notification deliveries failed and were retried; some customers received duplicates after fallback. Noting product impact but not data loss.
Tom Nguyen: Ok. Immediate mitigation done. Next actions: manual page covered, secret updated, incident-bot redeployed, notify-router fallback enabled.
Sara Li: Post-incident actions (quick):
- Add automation to update k8s secret when PagerFlow key rotates (owner: Maria)
- Incident-bot should emit an alert when it receives repeated 4xx/401 from PagerFlow (owner: Tom)
- Add an automated fallback that triggers SMS ring if >2 failed pages in 5m (owner: Sara)
- Run a tabletop on secret-rotation runbook (owner: Alex)
Maria Gomez: I'll add the secret-sync job and update runbook.
Alex Patel: I'll clean up duplicate notifications and add a short note to ops playbook.
ops-bot: Marking INC-4578 as resolved (root cause: PagerFlow API key rotated but k8s secret not updated -> incident-bot 401 -> suppressed/outbound pages failed).
Sara Li: Please add a timeline + assign follow-ups in the incident tracker.
Tom Nguyen: I'll open the postmortem doc and link to this thread.
ops-bot: Note: redeploy incident-bot at 1714509500 (k8s rollout timestamp).
Alex Patel: :thumbsup:
